name: Group Media Library Extra
description: Adds extra functionality to Group Media Library (group-scoped media management).
project_description:
Provides extra functionality and features to Group Media Library module.

 Back to top 

 FEATURES 
 Media library view: 
 The module provides a pluggable solution for altering the list of media items displayed in the Media Library. It allows you to define the media source per group type, as well as for content created outside of a group context (global content).

 The module includes several predefined media items sources:

 
 Own media items: Allows users to access only the media items they own. 
 Group's media items: It requires groupmedia module. Useful when users should only be able to use media items associated with the current group.
 
 Media without group: It requires groupmedia module. Active when content is created outside a group context. This helps prevent media belonging to a group from being used outside that group. 
 
 If none of the provided plugins meet your requirements, you can create your own custom plugin.

 Back to top 

 HOW TO USE 
 
 For setting up the media items source for a group type, visit the "Media library" tab in the group type. 
 For setting up the media items source for global content, visit the Groups >

 Settings > Media Library Extra Settings. 
 Back to top
